leadText:
Alola TV (Japanese: アローラテレビ Alola TV) is an -exclusive location in the Alola region. It first appeared in Crystal-Clear Sleuthing!. The Alola TV station has been the main television production and broadcasting hub in Alola for the past 55 years.

Alola TV employs many people from directors, camera operators, and makeup artists to actors and actresses. Event hostess and director George Charino are among them. Some of its famous works include Alolan Detective Laki (Japanese: アローラ探偵ラキ Alola Detective Laki), Alola Pokémon Quiz (Japanese: アローラポケモンクイズ Alola Pokémon Quiz), The Refreshing Trio: Alola Idols (Japanese: サンサン三人はアローラドリンキュン The Sparkling Trio is Alola DrinKyun), and Little Magikarp's Melody (Japanese: 小さなコイキングのメロディ Melody of the Small ).

The Alola TV facility has several film studios and rehearsal studios, and is surrounded by large open spaces ideal for larger production sets.

During This Magik Moment!, and came to watch compete in an episode of Alola Pokémon Quiz, but he lost by one question to Noah. Later, George Charino spotted and invited everyone to watch filming of the next installment of Little Magikarp's Melody. He also invited , , and to film an episode of The Refreshing Trio: Alola Idols after the lead actresses became stranded in Sinnoh because of a blizzard. Eventually, the main star of Little Magikarp's Melody, a nicknamed Karpy, was having difficulties controlling its voice and eventually evolved into a rampaging , but George was able to settle the situation. George then incorporated Karpy into The Refreshing Trio: Alola Idols episode as the main villain, Gyarados, which he pit against Lillie, Mallow, and Lana's characters.

Meanwhile, , who were auditioning for the upcoming 55th-year anniversary of Alola TV, managed to land a gig. Jessie was not thrilled about the action role she received for a film, and her teammates were also roped into filming. They later received a call back from Alola TV for more demanding roles, but the trio were hoping for speaking roles instead.
